source: Alice gave Bob the report. He showed it to Carol.
candidates:
past(give(Alice, Bob, Report))
past(show(Bob, Report, Carol))
backtranslation: Alice gave the report to Bob; Bob showed that report to Carol.
notes: Bob and Report are manually resolved. Stable spelling records an interpretation, not proof of identity.

source: Bob thinks Alice believes Carol is wrong.
backtranslation: Bob thinks that Alice believes Carol is wrong.
notes: No nested wrong(Carol) root is introduced.

source: Bob does not think Alice is wrong.
backtranslation: It is not the case that Bob thinks Alice is wrong.
notes: Negated belief differs from belief in a negation.

source: Bob thinks Alice is not wrong.
backtranslation: Bob thinks Alice is not wrong.
notes: The two trees in this contrast pair must not normalize together.

source: Alice spoke to Carol after she left.
backtranslation: Either Alice or Carol left before Alice spoke to Carol; which reading was intended is unresolved.
notes: These are alternative parses, not a disjunction asserted by the source and not two roots in one document.

source: If Carol confirms the numbers tomorrow, Bob will send the report.
backtranslation: Conditional on Carol confirming the numbers tomorrow, Bob will send the report.
notes: Tomorrow remains context-relative. The core does not interpret if as material implication.

source: Bob believes the server is down, but the server is running.
backtranslation: Bob believes the server is down, whereas it is running.
notes: A root query is not a semantic asserted-facts query: but remains opaque, so running(Server) is nested too.

source: Alice said the server was down. Later she corrected herself: the database was down.
backtranslation: Alice first said the server was down and later corrected that statement to say the database was down.
notes: A correction is preserved, not destructive replacement of the earlier report. This fixture does not decide the truth of either outage.

source: The cache may have caused the stale read.
backtranslation: It is possible that the cache caused the stale read.
notes: No cause(Cache, StaleRead) root or invented numeric probability.

source: If parsing fails, preserve the original payload and return an error without mutating state.
backtranslation: On a parse failure, preserve the original payload, return an error and do not mutate state.
notes: These are instruction contents, not executable control flow or assertions that a parse has already failed.

backtranslation: Alice said the exact words: Do not change main.
notes: Lexical quoting only encodes a symbol; quote/text are explicit ordinary vocabulary. No code is executed.

source: Bob called Carol, but she did not answer that call.
backtranslation: Bob placed call Call1 to Carol; Carol did not answer Call1.
notes: Call1 is an explicit shared discourse identifier, using a local call(event, caller, callee) convention. Tree paths alone cannot supply event identity.

backtranslation: Alice sent Bob the report by email.
notes: The same candidate is assigned to the passive paraphrase by this author; that is an oracle choice, not measured model convergence.

source: The report was emailed to Bob by Alice.
notes: See active: syntax checks validate the chosen structures, not independent translation quality.

backtranslation: Alice sent the report to Bob.
notes: Do not silently equate sending with receipt.

source: Bob received the report from Alice.
backtranslation: Bob received the report from Alice.
notes: Different source commitment from sent; retain different vocabulary.

source: Alice met Carol. She revised her own report.
backtranslation: Alice met Carol; either Alice revised her own report or Carol revised her own report.
notes: Whole-document alternatives preserve correlated choices. Two independent actor/owner candidate lists would incorrectly permit crossed readings.
